headline: Tophyun and Hwang Inhyeock drop winter duet MV
sub: 'Hot Pack in My Pocket' arrives just in time for the cold
caption:
Tophyun and Hwang Inhyeock have released the music video for their duet 'Hot Pack in My Pocket'.

The MV for the winter song (Korean title '주머니에 핫팩 하나') went up on Nov 22 at 6 PM KST on 1theK's official YouTube channel.

📌 Source: Official MV on 1theK
